username.title: AUX Cloud Username
username.description: Email address or phone number registered with AUX Cloud. Required when using the experimental AUX Home provider; not required for LAN-only mode.

password.title: AUX Cloud Password
password.description: Required when using the experimental AUX Home provider; not required for LAN-only mode.

provider.title: Cloud Provider
provider.description: Select the cloud service for your account. AC Freedom remains the default. AUX Home is experimental in this release and supports the EU region only.

region.title: Region
region.description: Select the AUX Cloud region that matches your account. The experimental AUX Home provider requires the EU region.

temperatureUnit.title: Temperature Unit
temperatureUnit.description: Select the unit used when displaying temperatures. Values are converted automatically when talking to AUX Cloud.

temperatureStep.title: Target Temperature Step
temperatureStep.description: Choose the increment for setpoints. 0.5 replicates AC Freedom, 1 limits adjustments to whole degrees. Fahrenheit mode enforces 1°F.

featureSwitches.title: Extra Feature Switches
featureSwitches.description: Expose optional HomeKit switches for AUX features like screen display, mildew prevention, self-clean, health, eco, and sleep modes.

pollInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How frequently the plugin should request updated state from AUX Cloud (enter a value between 30 and 600 seconds).

includeDeviceIds.title: Included Device IDs
includeDeviceIds.description: Optional list of AUX endpoint IDs to expose. Leave empty to include every discovered device.

excludeDeviceIds.title: Excluded Device IDs
excludeDeviceIds.description: Optional list of AUX endpoint IDs to skip after discovery.

commandRetryCount.title: Cloud Retry Attempts
commandRetryCount.description: Number of retry attempts when cloud response is slow or unavailable. Higher values = more reliable but slower feedback. 0 means cloud-only with no retry.

commandTimeoutMs.title: Cloud Command Timeout (ms)
commandTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each cloud command attempt. If the cloud doesn't respond within this time, the next retry is triggered.

controlStrategy.title: Control Strategy
controlStrategy.description: How to send commands to the device. 'local-first' attempts LAN control with cloud fallback; 'cloud-only' uses only the AUX Cloud API.

localControlEnabled.title: Enable Local Control
localControlEnabled.description: When enabled, commands are sent directly to the device over LAN when possible, falling back to AUX Cloud if LAN is unavailable.

expose.title: Exposure Mode
expose.description: How to expose ACs to smart home platforms. 'hap' = HomeKit only (default). 'matter' = Matter only (replaces HAP). 'both' = HAP for Apple Home + Matter for Alexa/Google simultaneously. Requires Homebridge 2.x with Matter plugin for 'matter' or 'both'.

enableMatter.title: Enable Matter (legacy)
enableMatter.description: Deprecated — use 'expose' instead. When true, equivalent to expose=matter.

devices.title: Device Mappings
devices.description: Device list. Supports LAN-only devices (no endpointId) and cloud+LAN devices. Use MAC as the primary identifier.

mac.title: MAC Address
mac.description: Device MAC address (required, hex with colons, e.g. 'aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff').

name.title: Display Name
name.description: Display name for LAN-only devices (no AUX Cloud account). Required when endpointId is not set.

ip.title: LAN IP
ip.description: Static LAN IP address. Optional if the device is reachable via discovery.

endpointId.title: Endpoint ID
endpointId.description: AUX Cloud endpoint ID. Required only for devices registered in AUX Cloud.

controlStrategy.title: Per-Device Control
controlStrategy.description: Force local-only or cloud-only control for this device (overrides global controlStrategy). Devices without endpointId are always local.

bridge.title: Register in
bridge.description: Register this device as a HomeKit (HAP) or Matter accessory. Only one bridge type can be active per device.

region.description: AUX Home is experimental in this release and supports the EU region only.
